# Cheat-Sheet Index {#sec-cheat-index .unnumbered}

Each content chapter ends with a two-column reference table of the
commands, rules, and terms introduced in that chapter. This appendix
collects those tables in one place. Every entry links to the full
table in its chapter, where the surrounding context explains any
term that is not self-explanatory.

## Part I: Foundations

**[Chapter 2 -- The Reproducibility Crisis](@sec-cheat-crisis)**
Terms and distinctions: reproducibility vs. replicability vs.
robustness; computational vs. statistical failure;
`RNGkind()`; the `stringsAsFactors` default change; the
determinant stack. These are the vocabulary the rest of
the book assumes.

**[Chapter 3 -- Levels of Reproducibility](@sec-cheat-levels)**
The L0-L3 ladder; the capture-vs.-validation distinction;
`zzc verify --full`; how each level is claimed and confirmed.
The single most referenced table in the book.

**[Chapter 4 -- Version Control](@sec-cheat-vc)**
Core git commands: `init`, `add`, `commit`, `status`, `log`,
`show`, `switch -c`, `remote add`, `push`, `tag`. The
`.gitignore` pattern syntax. The rule of thumb for commit
messages.

**[Chapter 5 -- The Research Compendium](@sec-cheat-compendium)**
The minimal R-package skin (`DESCRIPTION`, `NAMESPACE`, `R/`);
the Five Pillars; the raw-vs.-derived boundary test; the five
archetypes; progressive disclosure.

## Part II: Capturing the Environment

**[Chapter 6 -- Managing Dependencies](@sec-cheat-deps)**
`renv::init()`, `snapshot()`, `restore()`, `dependencies()`;
`zzrenvcheck` CI and development forms; CRAN snapshot URLs;
`options(renv.config.autoloader.enabled = FALSE)`.

**[Chapter 7 -- Containers](@sec-cheat-containers)**
`FROM image@sha256:`; `ARG PPM_SNAPSHOT`; `ENV` variables for
locale, timezone, and thread count; the two-stage `COPY` for
`renv`; `docker build`, `run`, `exec`, `inspect`; the
`--platform` flag.

**[Chapter 8 -- Backends and Runtimes](@sec-cheat-backends)**
Podman and Apptainer equivalents to Docker; `rix::rix()` and
`nix-shell`; Binder and Dev Containers; the L2 guarantee each
tool provides.

## Part III: Validation

**[Chapter 9 -- Literate Programming](@sec-cheat-literate)**
Inline R expressions; `knitr::opts_chunk$set()`; `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH`;
`make docker-render`; the five render landmines; the sealed-render
rule of thumb.

**[Chapter 10 -- Automating the Analysis](@sec-cheat-pipelines)**
Make syntax (`target: prerequisites`, tab-indented recipes,
`touch`); `targets` (`tar_target()`, `tar_make()`,
`tar_outdated()`, `tar_visnetwork()`); `snakemake --cores`.

**[Chapter 11 -- Testing and Code Quality](@sec-cheat-testing)**
`tinytest` expectations (`expect_equal`, `expect_true`, etc.);
`test_package()`; `exit_file()`; `make lint` / `make style`;
the `test-baseline*.R` naming convention; the stated-tolerance
rule.

**[Chapter 12 -- Continuous Integration](@sec-cheat-ci)**
`error-on: '"warning"'`; `zzrenvcheck` with `error_on_fail = TRUE`;
`renv::dependencies()`; the render gate; `docker build` on a
clean machine; `zzc verify --full`; the L3 rebuild requirement.

## Part IV: Collaboration and Stewardship

**[Chapter 13 -- Archiving and Sharing](@sec-cheat-archiving)**
`docker inspect` for digest retrieval; `apptainer build` from a
digest-pinned image; the two-layer (environment/packages) model;
the union lockfile; `rang` and `groundhog`; Zenodo and OSF
deposition; FAIR principles and DataCite metadata.
